name: ChatGPT (chatgpt.com)

capabilities.name: Chat stream
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the composer; SSE-streamed answer off the page (POST /backend-api/f/conversation, text/event-stream)
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)

capabilities.name: Conversation CRUD + history
capabilities.description: List/get/rename/delete conversations via /backend-api/conversation/* (endpoint literals in bundle; live shapes to verify)
capabilities.method: in-page fetch (Bearer access token + csrfToken) — VERIFIED-ENDPOINT / LIVE-SHAPE-TO-VERIFY

capabilities.name: Web search / tools toggle
capabilities.description: web_search + cloud_browser tool flags feed client_tools of the conversation request (flag literals in bundle)
capabilities.method: composer-sidebar toggle (site UI); exact tool-shape to-verify

capabilities.name: File upload / Estuary
capabilities.description: Attachment + artifact content via /backend-api/estuary/content and /backend-api/estuary/upload_content_bytes (upload_url_expiry, direct_azure/direct_aws strategies)

capabilities.name: Artifacts / Canvas (Canmore)
capabilities.description: window.CanmoreNative hook + artifact_* message fields; /conversation/{id}/textdocs endpoint
capabilities.method: site iframe/artifact-mode (read DOM evidence in bundle)

capabilities.name: GPTs (custom assistants)
capabilities.description: conversation_mode { kind: GizmoInteraction, gizmo_id } + model_slug on custom GPTs
capabilities.method: ui-path (site picker) — payload field verified, live walk to verify

auth.note: provider-catalog: chatgpt-web kind=cookie (Playwright storage-state JSON), chatgpt-web-codex kind=cookie (full ChatGPT Cookie header). Bundles: session from same-origin /api/auth/session -> Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>; token refresh via BroadcastChannel auth-session / access-token-refreshed-v1; cookies seen: __Secure-oai-is, __Secure-oai-employee-device. Bootstrap authStatus=logged_out on anonymous curl. Capture once headed, then fill session.lock.json.

analysisMethod: static curl + 15 JS bundles (~13MB) + SSR client-bootstrap JSON; no browser launched
